title: USG-UAP-D001, Congressional, White House, UFO-related Constituent Correspondence, 1998
doc_notes: This document is a collection of congressional correspondence regarding UFO inquiries and NASA's responses, containing several anecdotal reports of encounters.

encounters.summary: A constituent reported a sighting of a light rising vertically from Earth on the NASA channel, which was tracked by a shuttle camera before the feed was cut.
encounters.quote: I was surprised to see a light rising vertically from the bottom of the screen

encounters.summary: A constituent reported a 1963 sighting by Major Gordon Cooper of a glowing green object that was tracked by radar near Perth, Australia.
encounters.quote: glowing, greenish object ahead of him quickly approaching his capsule

encounters.summary: A constituent reported a 1951 sighting by Major Gordon Cooper of metallic, saucer-shaped discs over Western Germany.
encounters.quote: metallic, saucer-shaped discs at considerable altitude

encounters.summary: A constituent reported a 1951 sighting by Donald Slayton of a gray, saucer-shaped object that accelerated and disappeared.
encounters.quote: It looked like a saucer, a disk

encounters.summary: A constituent reported an abduction of three campers at Mt. Kidtardin, Maine.
